messages.subject: Error message: Warning message: In log(prop/PI) : NaNs produced
parts:
Can anyone tell me what this means:

Warning message:
In log(prop/PI) : NaNs produced


The model I"m running is a SEM with ordinal indicators, where I"m fitting two latent variables and regressing them on a third latent variable:

base<-"
  problem=~need+data
  toc=~toc_locs+toc_members+toc_acts+toc_dur+toc_dosage+toc_target+
    effective+toc_consistent+toc_align+outcomes_align+toc_comprehensive
  
  quality=~problem+toc+evd_tier+performance
  problem~~toc
"

base_fit<-sem(base,data=dt,ordered=c(
  "need","data","toc_locs","toc_members","toc_acts","toc_dur","toc_dosage","toc_target",
  "effective","toc_consistent","toc_align","outcomes_align","toc_comprehensive","problem",
  "evd_tier","performance"))
